title: Sequence-model iteration response (sequence model -> Rust worker)

status.description: component status of the cost prediction (Phase 1A/1B semantics); 'unsupported' means no number is returned and gpu_ms is null

confidence.description: low for decode b<=2 and host-bound eager mixed iterations (Phase 1B limitations) until a validated revision lifts it

gpu_ms.description: critical-path iteration wall (first kernel to last kernel end over ranks); median path in mode=median, mean of draws in mode=mc

host_lead_ms.description: GPU end of the previous iteration minus the earliest host start of this one (positive: host runs ahead); the worker's clock advance is gpu_ms, the lead is informational unless the worker models host occupancy

gpu_idle_gap_ms.description: GPU idle time between the previous iteration's end and this iteration's first kernel (host-bound iterations)

host_start_offset_ms.description: per-rank host start relative to the earliest host start

rank_end_offset_ms.description: per-rank GPU end relative to the iteration's first kernel

flags.description: rolled into the worker's CoverageFlags (simulator/src/timing/cache/interp.rs) for the run summary
